proof:
intro τ α hτ
constructor
· intro s hs
  have h := yui_aux_0007 T gamma R τ α s (fun _ => |α|*τ) hτ continuous_const (by
    intro r hr
    apply (yui_aux_0003 T gamma R α s r).trans
    apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ (abs_nonneg α)
    exact abs_le.mpr ⟨by linarith [hs.1, hr.2], by linarith [hs.2, hr.1]⟩)
  simp only [intervalIntegral.integral_const, sub_zero, smul_eq_mul] at h
  nlinarith
· have h0 := yui_aux_0007 T gamma R τ α 0 (fun r => |α|*r) hτ (continuous_const.mul continuous_id) (by
    intro r hr
    simpa [abs_of_nonneg hr.1] using yui_aux_0003 T gamma R α 0 r)
  have h1 := yui_aux_0007 T gamma R τ α τ (fun r => |α|*(τ-r)) hτ (continuous_const.mul (continuous_const.sub continuous_id)) (by
    intro r hr
    simpa [abs_of_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hr.2)] using yui_aux_0003 T gamma R α τ r)
  rw [intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul, integral_id] at h0
  rw [intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul, intervalIntegral.integral_sub intervalIntegrable_const (continuous_id.intervalIntegrable _ _), intervalIntegral.integral_const, integral_id] at h1
  simp only [sub_zero, zero_pow, smul_eq_mul] at h0 h1
  nlinarith
